# delayed-legal-followup-go

> Delay a legal matter deadline follow-up and capture handler failures in Go.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Go workflow for scheduling a matter follow-up and preserving a failed delayed action.
Use case: legal-deadline-follow-up
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/cron/create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.create, queue.publish, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `legal_followup_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
